_comment: Canonical LTR feature schema. Source of truth for both Python (training) and Go (serving). Append-only — never reorder, never re-use indices. Run `make check-feature-parity` after editing; it regenerates the language-specific files and fails CI if they drift.

features.name: bm25_rank
features.description: BM25 rank within query (1-indexed); 0 if not in BM25 set

features.name: knn_rank
features.description: k-NN rank within query (1-indexed); 0 if not in k-NN set

features.name: query_has_brand
features.description: Query contains a known brand token (0/1)

features.name: query_has_color
features.description: Query contains a known color token (0/1)

features.name: user_brand_affinity
features.description: User's click-share for the candidate's brand in [0,1]; 0 if unknown user
